[1] (ran3_tdoc_chunks R3-196580, sim=0.485)
After consulting with the RAN3 Vice-Chairs and having notified the RAN Chairman and the other RAN WG Chairmen, a per-company, per-Agenda-Item contribution quota is introduced in RAN3 starting at RAN3 #106. The rules are given in the Annex. Some adjustments may be made for RAN3 #107 depending on the situation at RAN3 #106. Once the rules are stable, the Chairman will eventually draft a CR to TR 30.531.
